statement: For feasible target group totals M_g=alpha+h_g choose zeta=epsilon/(100d), p_(g,i)=(m_(g,i)+zeta)/(M_g+|G_g|zeta), positive ordinary rationals with coordinate smoothing error<epsilon/100. Scalar mean error<=epsilon/8 plus proportion smoothing gives EVERY coordinate error<epsilon. All compiler/preprocessing/calls/precision and ordinary rational output have computable every-run polynomial-COMPLETE-BINARY cost for EACH fixed network, including boundary/zero components/infinite classes. This is full calibration for this genuinely coupled arbitrarily high-rank family, not every coupled R.
